what: A weather card no longer hangs on a slow forecast: every Open-Meteo call has a 4.5 s limit, a missed forecast is asked once more, then Verse's own edge copy (/api/weather, ten minutes per place) answers, and /api/weather itself gives up after 6 s. The weather exam had swung between 54 and 98 on the same asks (Paris, London, Tokyo, Seattle, Miami) as the card sat past 12 s; it measured 98.3 on live this run (tools/weather-wait.test.mjs, lists run 26)
